create_CocoEvaluator: create a CocoEvaluator instance with ground truth COCO data and a list of IoU types to evaluate
update_CocoEvaluator_predictions: update the CocoEvaluator with new model predictions to accumulate per-image evaluation results
prepare_bbox_detection_results: prepare model predictions into COCO detection format with bounding boxes, scores, and category labels
prepare_segm_segmentation_results: prepare model predictions into COCO segmentation format with RLE-encoded masks, scores, and labels
summarize_CocoEvaluator_results: summarize accumulated COCO evaluation results by printing IoU metrics for each evaluation type
